task: Improve the Vegetation/natural complexity score path without inventing render evidence: add construction-aware plaza tree pits and cause-based low understory, machine-enforce their lookdev/LOD constraints, and persist them through the existing quality-scene save/capture chain.

commits.message: Add cause-based tree-pit and understory ecology pass
Add machine-readable vegetation ecology lookdev contract
Enforce vegetation ecology on benchmark scene saves
Gate scene saves on vegetation ecology contract QA

implementation.lodPolicy: LOD0/1 retain stems plus foliage; LOD2/3 remove stems and reduce plant count; all four levels are renderer-distinct and use animated cross-fade.
implementation.densityCausality: candidate plants are deterministically thinned toward the nearest plaza/path/worn-path circulation pressure source rather than distributed as a uniform decorative ring
implementation.geometry: tree-pit soil uses a generated beveled-cylinder authored mesh asset; edging uses real-dimension chamfered-box mesh assets; low stems and foliage reuse the high-detail tree twig and leaf-spray mesh library; Unity Cube/Cylinder/Sphere primitives are rejected by QA
implementation.persistence: sceneSaving gate runs only after both HD_TreeMaster_* and GroundHighDetail exist, then validates the machine-readable ecology contract, rebuilds the ecology layer and runs structural QA before the benchmark save is allowed to complete

verification.branchDiffAtSubstantiveHead: 5 commits ahead, 0 behind startHead; four new UnityProject files before readiness bookkeeping; no Godot path touched

implementationReadiness.reasonNotIncreased: The remaining seven points are reserved for real Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification. Additional source coverage is not allowed to substitute for actual editor execution or native 4K evidence.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.evidenceNeeded: oblique/vegetation_grounding must show independent low plants, non-uniform density and credible root-zone layering without a stamped circular pattern

hero/ground_contact and grazing/tree_shadow_contact must show plaza trees entering maintained planting openings rather than uninterrupted pavement, with edging depth and no floating/interpenetrating hero geometry
soil/concrete must remain rough non-metallic dielectrics; understory foliage must retain coherent two-sided transmitted-light response under the midsummer sun
camera motion must not expose plant shimmer or visible population pop at the four understory LOD transitions
tree-pit maintenance and summer undergrowth must read as ordinary lived-in residential landscaping, not decorative fantasy or damage narrative

criticalDefectRiskAddressed: tree trunks intersecting hero paving without a construction interface
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner. On first available native render, stop speculative expansion and inspect oblique/vegetation_grounding, grazing/tree_shadow_contact and hero/ground_contact at 100 percent. Verify tree-pit depth, root contact, plant density, repeated leaf sprays, contact shadows, aliasing/shimmer and LOD transitions, then fix observed defects before adding further detail.
